expectation: Membrane-localised HLA-DR on a subset of cells: antigen-presenting cells (macrophages, DCs, B cells) and some activated T cells. Scattered single cells and clusters in stroma and immune-rich zones, partly on CD14+ cells, with tumour nests mostly negative.
observed: A: yellow is in patchy, cell-sized networks that differ by region and tile. Dense in stromal and immune zones, near-absent in blue tumour or epithelial areas and some tiles. B, C: sparse elongated stromal cells with dark gaps. D: a bright cell with membrane-like blobs and neighbours. E: membranous HLA-DR network overlapping part of the CD14 cells, plus HLA-DR-only cells.
why: HLA-DR marks a distinct, regionally clustered subset of cell-shaped objects, avoids nuclei-dense tumour areas, and partly co-localises with CD14 as the marker graph predicts.
